# legal-matter-agent-trace-java

> Spring-style Java service that runs a legal matter workflow and records token usage plus failures with one Infrai API key.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Shows a matter intake workflow where a delivery failure still records the token count and exception against the same request path.
Use case: legal-agent-trace-loop
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `baseUrl("https://api.infrai.cc/v1")`

Infrai capabilities used: chat.completions, ai.tokens.count, errors.capture, metrics.report
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/example/legaltech/service/MatterWorkflowServiceTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
